uncited: *   **CPU Mirrored Data Structure:** Maintains timestamps for all pool elements (nodes and bricks).
*   **GPU Framebuffer:** Uses Multiple Render Targets (MRTs) to store node usage information.
**Ray Traversal and Data Collection:** During rendering, each ray traverses the $N^3$-tree.
The GPU records the trajectory of used nodes.
To handle spatial coherence, rays are grouped into packages (e.g., $2 \times 2$).
**GPU Feedback:** The GPU outputs supplementary information about data usage and update needs alongside the color.
**CPU Update:** The CPU reads the GPU feedback.
It updates the timestamps of the corresponding pool elements (nodes and bricks) in its mirrored data structure.
**Cache Management:** The CPU manages the LRU policy.
When a new element is added, it replaces the oldest element (lowest timestamp).
